notes.title: Kamilia Release Date Update
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45069340/c0953d2f264690a4d98de86df05202c0fa468b07.png"]
Hello everyone,
Thank you so much for supporting Kamilia — whether by wishlisting the game, playing the demo, or simply following the project. It means a great deal.

After thoughtful consideration, the release of Kamilia is being rescheduled,

from Q4 2025 to Q2 2026.

Below are more details about the delay, along with a special reveal—



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45069340/724a278d3af6a8cc6627dd22923f4cbf3a246857.png"]

Why the Delay?

Kamilia is based on a novel written over a decade ago. Early in development, the plan was to adapt only the main parts of the original story.

But as development progressed, it became clear that many of those character-driven moments carried too much meaning to be left out.

Therefore, it was recently decided to include the full story as it was originally told, in order to create the complete emotional experience.

The additional time will also allow for some early chapters to be revisited and polished further.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45069340/05ce001af21ceccb8f1f4009fb620661904dc162.png"]
A Small Reveal 🤫
As a small token of gratitude for your patience, here’s something never shared before:
As stated on the Steam page, the game will have multiple endings, but here’s a more specific detail -
Kamilia will feature FOUR different endings,
along with different endings for some of the side characters.


Thanks again for your continued interest in Kamilia.



Warmly,
Raphael Barel,
RQ Play

notes.title: FULL PC & Mac Support + Cloud Sync Confirmed!
notes.content:
As we get closer to the DEMO launch next week, on April 1st, I'm happy to announce -

Kamilia will officially support both PC & Mac, and also fully support Steam Save Cloud Sync
So whether you're playing on Windows or macOS, you’ll be able to pick up right where you left off.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45069340/d6040567ff26de686c51ccd3d656444c79f26a24.jpg
Thanks for following the journey 🤍

notes.title: Kamilia DEMO Releases on April 1st 🕵️‍♂️✨
notes.content:
I'm thrilled to announce that the demo for Kamilia will be officially available next week,
on April 1st, 2025 — and nope, this isn’t an April Fools’ prank.
It’s real!!!

It’s the first tiny step into a MUCH larger story I’ve been building with care 🤍

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45069340/9c696b46627425a6b6970ea8bd460a75922a693c.gif 
The demo offers a short glimpse into Kamilia's world —
a taste of the mystery that lies ahead.

🕵️‍♂️ Investigate.

🎨 Reflect.

👁️ Begin to unravel what happened to Kamilia.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45069340/2a0bbaf63e6d1eec87cf69b66587fac8925b106c.gif
Thank you for wishlisting the game!

I’m looking forward to sharing this first peek into the game.
